Personal scope: tasks come from the authenticated user task list, filtered by the endpoint runtime approval department. This exact request context has no user-entered narrowing filter. The native My Tasks label is مهامي; this names the authenticated personal queue, not a team queue.

Pending population means the complete To Do queue from this operation with this exact filter context. It includes pending modification and external approval as well as pending review; it is not only Pending Review. On this personal Licensing My Application Tasks page, the actual Arabic To Do tab label is قيد الإنجاز (applications.subTabs.todo), and the My Tasks label is مهامي (applications.tabs.myTasks). In a reference to this page/tab or personal queue, the native label identifies the To Do pending-work view; it does not assert that every application status equals an English In Progress literal. It does not change the authenticated personal scope, runtime department or request filters. Explicit requests for a stored application/process status, additional status predicates, negation or another page/entity must retain those requirements rather than be converted to queue membership. The statistics card reuses the same label but is a different count source, not proof of list completeness.
The upstream personal task query is bound to the authenticated user. The exact request context and current permission must be verified; no literal user ID is stored in knowledge.
The To Do operation establishes queue membership; there is no generic row status literal Pending that replaces all pending workflow states.
taskStatus is the workflow node status in To Do responses. It is independent from application status.
Displayed Status for the uniquely matched application row. It is distinct from workflow taskStatus and a list card category. A status read alone does not establish missing required documents.

pagination.pageIndex: Request integer page number, starts at 1; Skip((pageIndex-1)*pageSize).
pagination.pageSize: Request integer maximum rows per page; UI default 10, choices 10/20/50/100. This is not a proven server maximum.
pagination.total: page.total counts rows of the selected view AFTER filters and BEFORE pagination. It is not necessarily distinct application count.
pagination.preservedContext: Keep all filters, identity, language and sort context fixed across pages; two agreeing scans are not a transactional snapshot.

requestFields.keyword: Case-insensitive substring of applicationNumber, serviceNameAr/serviceNameEn and applyForAr/applyForEn; not an exact unique lookup.
requestFields.serviceTypeId: String 1 is ALL SERVICE TYPES, not a Licensing department or Foreign Media selector. A different nonempty value filters serviceTypeId exactly.
requestFields.approvalStatus: To Do matches taskStatus; Completed matches myDecision.
requestFields.serviceCodes: Filter by stable service codes, not one service version ID.
requestFields.endTime: lastUpdatedTime < endTime.Date.AddDays(1). Source server time interpretation needs deployed verification.

fields.id: Application entity key; not a workflow task key.
fields.applicationNumber: Displayed application business number; no global uniqueness constraint was established from the inspected snapshot.
fields.taskId: Workflow task identifier and task detail route parameter. A single application can have multiple task IDs over time.
fields.dispositionCaseId: Nullable disposition identifier; the personal To Do projection deduplicates (id, dispositionCaseId). A nullable component cannot be silently dropped from a task-row identity.
fields.status: Application/process status display; group this field when the requested dimension is application status.
fields.taskStatus: To Do: workflow node; personal Completed: compatibility projection of myDecision.
fields.myDecision: Completed reviewer decision; a dash is not a workflow state.
fields.serviceCode: Stable service code shared by service versions.
fields.serviceNameEn: Service display; may be localized by response language.
fields.serviceCategoryNameEn: Service category display; may be localized.
fields.serviceTypeNameEn: Service type display; may be localized.
fields.applyForEn: Apply For display value; not the handler.
fields.lastUpdatedTime: Latest application timeline/update timestamp. Request startTime/endTime filter this field, even where a control label says Submission Time.
fields.sla: SLA value with business pause/state handling; use current supplied slaDescription rather than inventing clock calculations.
fields.slaDescription: Localized SLA display produced by the service; not a priority category.

relationships: To Do selects noncompleted canonical-instance rows and deduplicates by (id, dispositionCaseId). Completed deduplicates by id.

records.title: My Application Tasks SLA and ordering

sources.locator: Complete permitted licensing To Do field shape: taskDueTime, taskApprovalAt, taskStatusId, statusId and signed SLA. No record/count values embedded.

fields.statusId: Projected process state. PendingModification is 13 and pauses review SLA. Disposition Pending is 108; Verification is 109.
fields.taskDueTime: Normal approval-node due wall time in Asia/Dubai. A disposition case due date is a different clock.
fields.taskApprovalAt: Normal approval completion wall time in Asia/Dubai; null means the normal node clock uses the observation reference instant.
fields.taskStatusId: ApprovalNodeOrder key. ExternalApproval is 11. Active disposition rows have null taskStatusId.
fields.overdueDays: Signed elapsed review days at the same fixed reference instant as sla; exactly signed SLA minutes divided by 1440. Positive means overdue, null means paused or unavailable.

relationships: Review SLA measures workflow timing; certificate expiry is a separate clock.
The most overdue item has the maximum positive SLA value in the complete requested population. Rounded day labels can hide ties.
A page default sort can contain status/VIP buckets and is not proof of a global SLA maximum.
constraints: Today can be a query reference time rather than a submission-date filter; retain the requested meaning.
A general business priority or escalation rule is not defined by SLA alone.
Pending Modification and External Approval can pause/hide review SLA; use the current supplied value and display.
Zero is the due boundary, not a confirmed positive overdue duration.

A record-specific SLA question can be answered from its uniquely matched authorized task row when that row supplies the requested fields; a separate detail page is not required merely because the answer is a detail. Do not replace unavailable detail data with another record.

Full-population analysis uses the stable projected timestamps and status inputs from two matching scans, then calculates at one reference instant. Raw sla and rounded slaDescription change with wall time and are not suitable for strict cross-scan equality.

For Disposition Verification, reviewDue = submission.SubmittedOn + (reviewSla - initialReviewMinutes). Case TaskDueTime is not reviewDue. If these operands are absent from the authorized response, keep that row unconfirmed and obtain the appropriate detail evidence; never reuse the normal-node formula.
Displayed rounded labels are presentation only; order by signed numeric minutes and state the reference time. Calculated values are source-defined computations, not a transactional server snapshot.
Apply explicit paused-state exclusions before filtering the nullable computed clock. Do not convert nulls to zero. Remaining active rows with absent clock inputs stay unconfirmed.

Distinguish documented paused rows from unverified active rows. Known paused rows are excluded by the documented status predicates; do not describe these excluded rows as unknown. Report genuine remaining unknown rows only when the computed receipt identifies them.
No hypothetical priority choices; clarify only evidenced alternatives that change the ranking.

For a verified requested personal population and time meaning, give read-only SLA/status priority advice with its basis. SLA is not business urgency or risk; preserve ties, paused/unknown clocks and coverage.

Do not narrow tasks to MyTodoPage, change ordering, or map today to due/created/submitted/updated dates or last7 without evidence. State missing business-priority definitions; do not invent or select them.

bindings.meaning: Signed minutes: positive overdue; negative time remaining. Null is unavailable/paused, not zero.
Strictly positive signed minutes identify overdue review work; retain unknown nulls separately.

Exclude explicitly paused process states 13/108 first, then ExternalApproval task node 11, before evaluating positive signed SLA. These known paused rows are outside overdue population, not unknown. Null or unavailable clock on any other row remains unknown. Disposition Verification 109 requires its own documented clock inputs and cannot be silently excluded.
The current rendered review SLA text, including its duration unit and Overdue/Due In suffix; null or -- is not a zero duration.
Signed elapsed review days at the same fixed reference instant as sla; exactly signed SLA minutes divided by 1440. Positive means overdue, null means paused or unavailable.

Exclude explicitly paused process states 13/108 first, then ExternalApproval task node 11, before evaluating positive signed SLA. These known paused rows are outside overdue population, not unknown. Null or unavailable clock on any other row remains unknown. Disposition Verification 109 requires its own documented clock inputs and cannot be silently excluded.

aliases: ترتيب الأكثر تأخرا حسب اتفاقية مستوى الخدمة
bindings.meaning: Ranks observed signed review-clock minutes numerically, greatest positive overdue value first. Preserve ties, missing values and the complete requested population. This ordering is not a definition of business urgency or a universal priority policy. Rank only rows whose review clock is applicable: exclude the explicitly documented paused process states and external-approval task node first. Retain negative non-overdue active values; do not apply a positive-SLA filter unless overdue-only was also requested. Describe the paused class as outside SLA ranking, never as missing data or as zero. Any other missing clock remains unknown and must not be silently dropped.

temporalDerivations.description: For normal workflow tasks, compute signed minutes from the due time at one fixed UTC reference; completed tasks use taskApprovalAt. Pending Modification, External Approval and Pending Disposition have null review SLA. Active Disposition Verification is excluded from this formula: its clock depends on submission time and remaining review budget. Null or unverified clocks are not zero and must be reported separately.
Elapsed review days = signed elapsed minutes / 1440 with the identical documented workflow clock and pause rules.

searchMetadata.descriptionEnglish: Read all authorized application rows; verify stable timestamps and statuses in two scans, compute numeric review SLA at one reference instant, deduplicate application identities and sort without a hidden row limit. Paused clocks remain null. Apply positive-SLA filtering only when overdue-only was requested; business urgency is a separate policy.
